scoped_paint_overlays.exact_append:
/* Unknown-price actions remain legible while disabled; pricing still requires explicit review. */
.initial-import [aria-label="Cuci gagal harga belum diketahui"] button:disabled { opacity: 1; border-style: dashed; }

/* A blocked QC inverse remains readable without enabling the authoritative action. */
.clq-history [data-qc-inspection-id] .clq-reversal button:disabled { opacity: 1; border-style: dashed; }
